source.snippet: Is there a way in a compose file for a container to reach containers in the same compose that are behind gluetun, those that are behind tailscale and also a service running on host? containers to be behind gluetun have a network_mode: service:gluetun. containers to be behind tailscale have a network_mode: service:tailscale and the container that can access all of them not sure how to do it

problem_statement: Self-hosting developers and small DevOps teams running Docker Compose stacks with multiple VPN network modes (e.g., Gluetun + Tailscale simultaneously) have no straightforward way to route traffic between all container groups and the host, forcing complex manual workarounds or architectural compromises.
target_segment: Self-hosted infrastructure operators, indie developers, and small-team DevOps engineers running Docker Compose with VPN overlays
notes: Single signal but from a professional/operator context — someone running a multi-VPN homelab or small business stack. Pain is concrete and technical. Monetization angle: a managed config generator or Docker Compose template service for complex VPN topologies. Willingness to pay not explicit, but self-hosters increasingly pay for tools that save hours of debugging.
